description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 25

tasks.reason: Java 25 is the latest LTS release, bringing improved performance, security patches, and modern language features. Upgrading ensures long-term support and access to the latest JVM enhancements.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to version 25. Update build configuration (pom.xml or build.gradle) to target Java 25 source/target compatibility. Ensure all dependencies are compatible with Java 25. Fix any compilation issues or deprecated API usages introduced by the upgrade.
tasks.summary: Upgraded project from Java 21 to Java 25. Updated pom.xml java.version property to 25, and updated Dockerfile build and runtime stages to use eclipse-temurin:25. Spring Boot 4.0.1 is fully compatible with Java 25. Build succeeded and all dependencies are CVE-clean.
